title: Mo and the Little Lost Spaceship

beats.chapter: Mo and the Little Lost Spaceship
beats.text: Mo and the Little Lost Spaceship
Tonight, {child|little one}, Mo is flying higher than ever before. Past the clouds, past the moon, all the way to the stars.
Whirr... whirr... beep. Look, a little round spaceship, with a friendly visitor inside. Its name is Pip.
Pip has been exploring all day. Now Pip is sleepy, and cannot remember which planet is home.
Mo has an idea. We can help Pip find the way home.
Make a rabbit with your hand. Moon rabbits know every rock on the moon.
A moon rabbit! Long ears, soft paws. Hop on, Mo.
Hop, hop, over the moon rocks. Pip's little spaceship follows behind.
The moon rabbit sits down by a crater, and twitches its nose goodbye.
Now there is a long river of stars, sparkling all across the sky. How do we get across?
Make a fish: a flat hand, fingers together. Swim through the river of stars.
A star fish! It swims through the sky, as if the stars were water.
Swish, swish, through the twinkling stars.
The star fish swims away, leaving a trail of sparkles.
Pip's planet is very far up, with a ring around it, like a hoop. We need someone who can glide high.
Make a swan: a flat hand, bent down at the wrist, like a long neck and a beak.
A swan! Did you know there is a swan made of stars, up in the real night sky?
Glide up, up, gently, toward the planet with the ring.
The swan folds its wings, and sails back to its place among the stars.
There is Pip's planet. But it is all dark. The little home light has gone out.
Look! A tiny shooting star is zooming by, just for us.
Cup your hands together, softly, and catch the shooting star.
You caught it. It is warm and tingly, and very bright.
Now open your hands, and send the star up to light Pip's home.
The little window on the planet glows. Pip can see the way home now.
Whirr, whirr. Pip's spaceship flies up and lands, softly, on the planet with the ring. Home at last.
Goodnight, Pip. Goodnight, stars. And goodnight, {child|little one}. Mo will see you tomorrow.
The End
The End
